messages.content: You are BioGPT, an expert compiler architect. Translate the provided natural language biological protocol into valid, deterministic BioScript code for execution on a microfluidic biochip.

Perform a digital microfluidic hemagglutination assay suite for blood typing, donor compatibility, and hematocrit analysis. First, reconstitute lyophilized blood-typing antibodies (anti-A, anti-B, anti-AB, anti-D) and hematocrit reagent using reconstitution solvent by mixing for 5s. Next, dispense whole blood unit-droplets for each parallel test. Merge each blood droplet with its corresponding reconstituted reagent and mix for 10s. Perform DAAD imaging detection for 5s on the blood-typing panel and apply threshold conditions to dispose of nonagglutinated droplets. Then, perform quantitative DAAD scoring on the hematocrit droplet, dispose of it if below threshold, and finally clear all remaining test droplets from the array.

module fluorescence

manifest whole_blood
manifest reconstitution_solvent
manifest anti_A
manifest anti_B
manifest anti_AB
manifest anti_D
manifest hematocrit_reagent

instructions:

solvent_a = dispense 1 units of reconstitution_solvent
solvent_b = dispense 1 units of reconstitution_solvent
solvent_ab = dispense 1 units of reconstitution_solvent
solvent_d = dispense 1 units of reconstitution_solvent
solvent_hct = dispense 1 units of reconstitution_solvent

dry_a = dispense 1 units of anti_A
dry_b = dispense 1 units of anti_B
dry_ab = dispense 1 units of anti_AB
dry_d = dispense 1 units of anti_D
dry_hct = dispense 1 units of hematocrit_reagent

reagent_a = mix solvent_a with dry_a for 5s
reagent_b = mix solvent_b with dry_b for 5s
reagent_ab = mix solvent_ab with dry_ab for 5s
reagent_d = mix solvent_d with dry_d for 5s
reagent_hct = mix solvent_hct with dry_hct for 5s

blood_a = dispense 1 units of whole_blood
blood_b = dispense 1 units of whole_blood
blood_ab = dispense 1 units of whole_blood
blood_d = dispense 1 units of whole_blood
blood_hct = dispense 1 units of whole_blood

test_a = mix blood_a with reagent_a for 10s
test_b = mix blood_b with reagent_b for 10s
test_ab = mix blood_ab with reagent_ab for 10s
test_d = mix blood_d with reagent_d for 10s
test_hct = mix blood_hct with reagent_hct for 10s

score_a = detect fluorescence on test_a for 5s
score_b = detect fluorescence on test_b for 5s
score_ab = detect fluorescence on test_ab for 5s
score_d = detect fluorescence on test_d for 5s

if (score_a <= 15) {
    dispose test_a
}

if (score_b <= 15) {
    dispose test_b
}

if (score_ab <= 15) {
    dispose test_ab
}

if (score_d <= 15) {
    dispose test_d
}

hct_score = detect fluorescence on test_hct for 5s

if (hct_score <= 15) {
    dispose test_hct
}

dispose test_a
dispose test_b
dispose test_ab
dispose test_d
dispose test_hct
